run_tid_handler: run the tid_handler function to process TID2008 or TID2013 dataset images into quality classification buckets
create_tid2008_dataset: create a DownloadableDataset definition for the TID2008 image quality dataset with download URL and handler
create_tid2013_dataset: create a DownloadableDataset definition for the TID2013 image quality dataset with download URL and handler
summarize_find_bucket: summarize the find_bucket function that maps distortion values to one of five quality buckets
review_gen: review the gen generator function that yields image examples with quality bucket labels from BMP files
